description: Returns the open, unexpired listings and offers on one domain, each as the EIP-712 typed data its wallet signed plus the signature, the signer and whether it is an ordinary wallet or a contract wallet (EIP-1271). For reading what a name is listed at or offered for, and for confirming a listing was really signed by the wallet it names. Read-only. Cannot sign, accept, cancel or move anything. A signed order is a statement by a wallet, not a sale: accepting one opens a trade that both people still arm. Off on this deployment until enabled.
name: get_signed_orders
